get.description: Returns lowest compliance and remaining error budget (0-1 ratios) for an SLO grouping slice over a time window.

parameters.description: Grouping label pairs that identify the slice to evaluate, passed as repeated query values. Each entry is one pair: the substring before the first comma is the label name (must not contain a comma), and the remainder of the entry (which may contain commas, or be empty) is the label value. Example: grouping_key_value=service,api&grouping_key_value=region,eu-west-1 or grouping_key_value=service, for an empty value. When omitted or empty, every permutation is considered. When provided, each label name must appear at most once and must be one of the SLO configured grouping labels; the slice includes every atomic permutation whose labels match the given pairs (a proper subset of grouping dimensions matches all permutations that agree on those labels). `lowestCompliance` and `lowestRemainingErrorBudget` are the minimum ratio across those matching permutations, not ratios recomputed from summed events across omitted dimensions.
parameters.name: grouping_key_value

When provided, each label name must appear at most once and must be one of the SLO configured grouping labels; the slice includes every atomic permutation whose labels match the given pairs (a proper subset of grouping dimensions matches all permutations that agree on those labels). `lowestCompliance` and `lowestRemainingErrorBudget` are the minimum ratio across those matching permutations, not ratios recomputed from summed events across omitted dimensions.

parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound of the evaluation window. When omitted, defaults to the start of the SLO configured evaluation window ending at the effective upper bound: for rolling windows, the configured lookback; for calendar-aligned windows, the UTC month-start of the calendar month that contains the instant just before the effective upper bound (earlier values are clamped to that month start). Because `to` is exclusive, when the effective upper bound is 00:00 UTC on the first day of a month, that default is the start of the previous UTC calendar month. RFC 3339 UTC date-time on a whole-minute instant (suffix `Z`, seconds `00`, no fractional seconds).
parameters.name: from

When omitted, defaults to the start of the SLO configured evaluation window ending at the effective upper bound: for rolling windows, the configured lookback; for calendar-aligned windows, the UTC month-start of the calendar month that contains the instant just before the effective upper bound (earlier values are clamped to that month start). Because `to` is exclusive, when the effective upper bound is 00:00 UTC on the first day of a month, that default is the start of the previous UTC calendar month. RFC 3339 UTC date-time on a whole-minute instant (suffix `Z`, seconds `00`, no fractional seconds).

parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound of the evaluation window. When omitted, defaults to the current time with sub-minute precision truncated toward zero to the preceding whole UTC minute (for example 12:30:37Z becomes 12:30:00Z). When set, RFC 3339 UTC date-time on a whole-minute instant (suffix `Z`, seconds `00`, no fractional seconds). For calendar-aligned SLOs, a value of 00:00 UTC on the first day of a month covers through the end of the previous month only (no instants in the new month are included).

ApmFilter.title: ApmFilter

key.description: Label/tag name to filter on. Required. A missing or empty key is rejected.

matchOperator.description: How literals on `key` are compared. Every item in `apmSli.filters` must use the same mode: all implicit (legacy) or all explicit — mixing modes in one list is rejected. Implicit: omitted or `APM_FILTER_MATCH_OPERATOR_UNSPECIFIED` on every item — multiple items with the same `key` OR-merge literals with exact (IS) comparison; sending `UNSPECIFIED` is equivalent to omitting the field (neither is stored as explicit `IS`). Explicit: `APM_FILTER_MATCH_OPERATOR_IS`, `STARTS_WITH`, `ENDS_WITH`, or `INCLUDES` on every item — each item is a separate AND criterion; OR applies only among literals in that item (explicit `IS` differs from implicit when several items share a `key`). Items on different keys are AND-combined. Pattern operators use literal substring matching (not caller-supplied regex). Applies only when the item has at least one literal: non-empty `values`, or deprecated `value` when `values` is omitted or empty (non-empty `values` takes precedence over `value`); otherwise rejected.

value.description: Deprecated: use values instead. Single value to match (kept for backward compatibility)

items.description: Preferred: multiple values to match (OR semantics, e.g. status IN [500, 503])

values.description: Preferred: multiple values to match (OR semantics, e.g. status IN [500, 503])

ApmFilter.description: Key-value filter for APM metrics. Supports single value (legacy) or multiple values (OR semantics)

ApmFilterMatchOperator.description: How each entry in the filter's `values` list is compared to the metric label named in `key`. Case-sensitive. IS: exact equality. STARTS_WITH: prefix. ENDS_WITH: suffix. INCLUDES: contains the value. Entries in `values` are literal strings (not caller regex); metacharacters are escaped in the PromQL label matcher. Multiple values are OR.

computedAt.description: Time at which the evaluation was performed, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp on a whole-minute instant (suffix `Z`, no fractional seconds).

effectiveFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound of the evaluation window that was applied, after defaults, as an RFC 3339 UTC whole-minute instant (suffix `Z`). For calendar-aligned SLOs whose effective upper bound is 00:00 UTC on the first day of a month, equals the start of the previous UTC calendar month when the lower bound was defaulted or clamped to month start; a requested `from` later than that month start is applied unchanged (subject to month-start clamping only when earlier).

effectiveTo.description: Exclusive upper bound of the evaluation window that was applied, after defaults, as an RFC 3339 UTC whole-minute instant (suffix `Z`).

effectiveWindowCompleteData.description: When true, recorded source metrics for the evaluated grouping slice fully cover the applied evaluation window between `effectiveFrom` and `effectiveTo`, so `lowestCompliance` and `lowestRemainingErrorBudget` may be treated as final for that window. When false, the evaluation used partial data within that window. Completeness is determined only from `effectiveFrom` and `effectiveTo` (including after request defaults); it is independent of whether the SLO configured rolling time frame has matured since creation or last revision. For example, a short, fully recorded custom window may report true here while permutations in the configured rolling window still have incomplete historical coverage.

lowestCompliance.description: Lowest compliance ratio among atomic permutations that match the evaluated grouping slice for the applied evaluation window, in the range 0-1 (minimum of per-permutation compliance ratios, not compliance from pooled good/total counts). When the slice is a single atomic permutation, this equals that permutation's compliance. When there are no events in the window, the value is 0.

lowestRemainingErrorBudget.description: Lowest remaining error budget ratio among atomic permutations that match the evaluated grouping slice for the applied evaluation window, in the range 0-1 (minimum of per-permutation remaining error budget ratios). When the slice is a single atomic permutation, this equals that permutation's remaining error budget. When there are no events in the window, the value is 0.

GetSloStatusResponse.description: Lowest compliance and remaining error budget over the atomic permutations that match the requested grouping slice (minimum of each permutation's ratio, not a recomputed ratio from pooled event counts), for the applied evaluation window (`effectiveFrom` inclusive, `effectiveTo` exclusive). Values are normalized ratios in the range 0-1.

grouping.description: Grouping labels derived by the server from the SLI. A value sent by the client is rejected.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the SLO. Required. A missing or empty name is rejected.

ownershipTags.description: Service, environment, and team ownership configuration for the SLO group and its permutations.

productType.description: Product type: APM for application performance monitoring SLOs, UNSPECIFIED for manual/custom SLOs

requestBasedMetricSli.description: Deprecated: use `sliDefinition.requestBased.custom` instead, which takes the same `goodEvents` and `totalEvents` queries.

revision.description: Revision of the SLO. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored.

sliDefinition.description: Definition of the SLI: how it counts (request-based or window-based) and where its values come from (custom metric queries or APM). Replaces the deprecated `requestBasedMetricSli`, `windowBasedMetricSli` and `apmSli`. A request must set either `sliDefinition` or one of the deprecated fields. When `sliDefinition` is set, it takes precedence and the deprecated fields are ignored. Responses always include `sliDefinition`, and also include the matching deprecated field when the SLI can be expressed with it.

sloTimeFrame.description: Time frame the SLO is evaluated over. The day-based values, `SLO_TIME_FRAME_1_DAY` through `SLO_TIME_FRAME_30_DAYS`, are rolling windows that cover that many days up to the time of evaluation. `SLO_TIME_FRAME_CALENDAR_MONTH` covers the current calendar month in UTC, from the start of the month up to the time of evaluation, and starts over at the beginning of each month. SLO results are calculated per whole minute in UTC, so the window used may differ from these bounds by up to one minute.

sloType.description: SLO type derived by the server from the SLI. A window-based metric SLI still reads SLO_TYPE_REQUEST. A value sent by the client must match the SLI type; a different value is rejected.

targetThresholdPercentage.description: Target compliance percentage threshold for the SLO (e.g., 99.9 for three nines).

type.description: Deprecated: SLO type string. Set by the server from the SLI; a value sent by the client is ignored.

updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored.

windowBasedMetricSli.description: Deprecated: use `sliDefinition.windowBased` instead. Set `window` and `missingDataStrategy` there, and `query`, `comparisonOperator` and `threshold` in its `custom` source.

SloOwnershipTag.title: SloOwnershipTag

items.description: Metric label names to use as sources (label-driven). Actual values come from series at query time. Empty if not using label-driven for this dimension.

labelKeys.description: Metric label names to use as sources (label-driven). Actual values come from series at query time. Empty if not using label-driven for this dimension.

items.description: Flat, deduplicated union of staticValues and the values resolved from labelKeys across observed permutations (empties excluded). Empty when neither source yields any value. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored.

resolvedValues.description: Flat, deduplicated union of staticValues and the values resolved from labelKeys across observed permutations (empties excluded). Empty when neither source yields any value. Set by the server; a value sent by the client is ignored.

items.description: Group-wide static values (broad). Empty if not using broad for this dimension.

staticValues.description: Group-wide static values (broad). Empty if not using broad for this dimension.

SloOwnershipTag.description: Ownership for one dimension (service, environment, or team). static_values are group-wide (broad) assignments. label_keys are metric label names whose values are read per permutation (label-driven). Both may be set; when both lists are empty, that dimension is unset.

SloOwnershipTags.title: SloOwnershipTags
SloOwnershipTags.description: Service, environment, and team ownership for the SLO group. At most one SloOwnershipTag per dimension; omit a dimension when unset.

WindowBasedMetricSli.title: WindowBasedMetricSli
WindowBasedMetricSli.description: Definition of a window-based SLI based on metrics

WindowBasedSli.title: WindowBasedSli

apm.description: Window value generated from APM span data for the selected services.

custom.description: Custom metric query yielding the value of each window, and how it is compared to a threshold.

missingDataStrategy.description: How a window without data is counted.

window.description: Size of each evaluated time window. Required.

WindowBasedSli.description: Window-based SLI. The source yields one value per `window` and decides whether that window is good. Exactly one of `custom` or `apm` must be set.
